results.text: Good day, and thank you for standing by. [#0](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-0)
Welcome to the Elis Full Year 2025 Results Webcast and Conference Call. [#1](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-1)
[Operator Instructions] Please be advised that today's conference is being recorded. [#2](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-2)
I would now like to hand the conference over to your first speaker today, Mr. Martire. [#4](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-4)
Please go ahead. [#5](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-5)
Thank you. [#7](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-7)
Good morning, and welcome to the Elis 2025 Annual Results Presentation. [#8](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-8)
I'm Xavier Martire, CEO of Elis, and I am in London today with our CFO, Louis Guyot. [#9](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-9)
We are pleased to present a year of strong operational execution and continued financial progress. [#10](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-10)

Over the next hour, we will walk you through our business highlights, our financial performance and the progress we have made on our CSR road map. [#12](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-12)
After I review the operational highlights of the year, I will hand over to Louis, who will detail our 2025 financial results. [#13](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-13)

I will then return to provide an update on our CSR achievements before discussing our outlook for 2026 in what remains a complex and uncertain international environment. [#14](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-14)
We will then open the floor to your questions. [#15](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-15)
And after our call, Nicolas Buron will be available to answer any of your questions offline. [#16](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-16)
Before we begin, please take the time to read the disclaimer. [#17](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-17)
Let me start with the key message of this presentation. [#19](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-19)
'25 was another year of resilient growth, disciplined execution and financial strengthening for Elis. [#20](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-20)

In a macroeconomic environment that remained mixed across Europe and volatile in Latin America, we delivered revenue of [ EUR 4,796.8 million ], representing growth of 4.9% compared to 2024. [#21](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-21)
At constant exchange rate, growth reached 5.5% with organic growth of 3.8%. [#22](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-22)
Adjusted EBITDA increased by 5.6% to reach [ EUR 1.701 million ]. [#23](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-23)
Importantly, the EBITDA margin improved again by 20 bps, reaching 35.4%. [#24](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-24)

This confirms our ability to continue expanding margins even in the context of cost inflation and regulatory headwinds in certain regions. [#25](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-25)
Adjusted EBIT rose by 4.6% to EUR 766.6 million, with the margin stable at 16%. [#27](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-27)
Fully diluted headline earnings per share increased by 5.2% to EUR 1.85. [#28](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-28)
Since 2019, excluding the pandemic years, our EPS trajectory demonstrates consistent value creation. [#29](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-29)
Free cash flow reached EUR 358.6 million, up by EUR 12.3 million year-on-year, reflecting the strength of our operating model. [#30](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-30)

Finally, our leverage ratio declined 0.1x to 1.75x at year-end, in line with our capital allocation strategy and confirming the continued strengthening of our balance sheet. [#31](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-31)
But beyond the strong financial metrics, what is particularly important this year is the quality of execution behind them. [#33](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-33)
We delivered strong commercial momentum despite a challenging macroeconomic environment, particularly in Europe. [#34](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-34)
This performance continues to be supported by the structural growth of outsourcing across our markets. [#35](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-35)

We pursued the further rollout of our service offering across all geographies, expanding both our client base and our penetration within existing accounts. [#36](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-36)
Pricing remained positive as we implemented adjustments designed to offset cost inflation in a disciplined and granular manner. [#37](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-37)

We also continued the active execution of our targeted acquisition strategy, completing value-creating bolt-on transactions that strengthen our network density and enhance our local positioning. [#39](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-39)

Finally, continuous process optimization across our plants and logistics operations drove further productivity gains, reinforcing our operational excellence and supporting margin resilience. [#40](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-40)

So taken together, 2025 once again illustrates the strength of our business model, balanced growth, disciplined capital allocation, operational efficiency and continued financial deleveraging. [#41](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-41)
Let's now look at revenue in more detail. [#43](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-43)
At constant exchange rate, revenue increased by 5.5%. [#44](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-44)

Organic growth reached 3.8%, supported by continued structural outsourcing trends and solid commercial momentum across most geographies. [#45](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-45)
Hospitality delivered a strong summer season and a solid performance in December, helping offset softer activity in certain quarters. [#46](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-46)
Pricing remained favorable, reflecting disciplined adjustments implemented to offset cost base inflation, particularly wage inflation. [#47](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-47)
M&A contributed 1.8% to growth in 2025. [#49](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-49)
Acquisitions completed over the last 2 years added approximately EUR 80 million to revenue this year. [#50](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-50)
ForEx had a negative impact of 0.7%, mainly due to the evolution of Latin America currencies and the British pound. [#51](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-51)
Overall, this performance reflects a healthy balance between organic growth, bolt-on acquisitions and disciplined pricing. [#52](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-52)
Moving on to the next slide. [#54](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-54)
Our revenue growth benefited and will continue to benefit from positive market trends across our regions. [#55](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-55)

First of all, the COVID pandemic, as well as the many safety standards over the last decade, especially in food industry, have resulted in a higher demand for hygiene and protective equipment for workers. [#56](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-56)

Secondly, our growth in the health care business has been and will continue to be correlated with the aging of population in both Europe and Latin America. [#57](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-57)
Third, the continued development of tourism directly drives our hospitality activity. [#59](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-59)

The underlying growth trends might be different today from what they were a decade or 2 decades ago, but nevertheless, the industry continues to grow. [#60](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-60)
The new trends encompass sustainable tourism, ecotourism and responsible travel. [#61](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-61)

Hotel groups are addressing this new clients' needs through modernization of infrastructure and use of circular services such as those proposed by Elis. [#62](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-62)

Fourth, the growing need for traceability and professional workwear as well as European regulation result in a steady development of outsourcing. [#64](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-64)
Last, we see more and more tenders coming with one or several CSR criteria, especially in Central and Northern Europe. [#65](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-65)

Our circular services perfectly address these evolving needs, and Elis is clearly well ahead of its competitors on that front, creating a competitive edge and room for growth. [#66](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-66)
Let's now turn to Slide 8, which highlights the structural foundation of our organic growth. [#68](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-68)

Our long-term ambition is clear: progressively bring other geographies closer to the level of maturity we have achieved in France in terms of footprint, density and service breadth. [#69](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-69)
France shows what our model can deliver at full scale. [#70](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-70)
We cover virtually all end markets, offer the full range of services and serve customers of all sizes. [#71](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-71)
The density and breadth creates a virtuous cycle of cross-selling, operational efficiency and pricing discipline. [#72](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-72)
Outside France, no country has yet reached that same level of maturity, and that gap represents opportunity. [#74](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-74)

We are closing it through several levers: increasing network density; expanding our offer to smaller customers as scale improves; and rolling out additional services such as pest control and cleanroom activities, which benefit from strong structural hygiene trends. [#75](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-75)
We are also targeting specific growth pockets, for example, resident [ cleaning ] services in the U.K. [#76](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-76)
and Spain, where outsourcing penetration remains relatively low. [#77](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-77)
All of this is supported by continued investment in local sales team. [#78](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-78)
In short, our strategy is not to change the model, but to scale it market by market with discipline and consistency. [#79](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-79)
The next slide virtually illustrates this point. [#81](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-81)

Rather than reviewing each country individually, the objective here is to provide a clear picture of relative market maturity across our footprint. [#82](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-82)

In the heat map, we are looking at -- green countries represent markets where we see significant structural headroom for development, whether in terms of outsourcing penetration, service portfolio, depth of customer segmentation. [#83](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-83)
The yellow markets are more advanced, but still offer incremental opportunities. [#84](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-84)
France, shown in orange, stands as our reference point, the most mature integrated version of our model. [#85](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-85)
What is particularly encouraging is that the majority of our footprint remains in green. [#87](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-87)
This means that structurally, most of our markets are still earlier in their development curve compared to France. [#88](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-88)

As density increases and capabilities expand locally, these markets can progressively unlock the same levers, broader service penetration, deeper cross-selling and access to a wider customer base. [#89](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-89)
This geographical mix give us strong long-term visibility on organic growth even in a challenging macroeconomic environment. [#90](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-90)
Moving to the next slide. [#92](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-92)
M&A activity in 2025 was particularly dynamic. [#93](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-93)

We continued to execute our strategy of targeted value-creating bolt-on acquisitions, contributing approximately plus 1.8% to full year revenue growth and further strengthening our network density in resilient end markets. [#94](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-94)

In Spain, we acquired Carsan near Madrid and Bugaderia Neutral in the Barcelona area, both focused on hospitality, generating around EUR 10 million and EUR 13 million in revenue, respectively, in 2025. [#95](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-95)
In Germany, we acquired Ernst Wascherei, operating 2 plants, serving mainly health care clients, with nearly EUR 19 million in revenue. [#96](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-96)
One site is new and offers significant spare capacity. [#97](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-97)

We also announced the acquisition of Larose, which operates 2 plants in Berlin and Schonebeck and generated around EUR 13 million in revenue. [#99](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-99)

In Switzerland, we acquired Bodensee, serving hospitals and hotels, with approximately EUR 23 million in revenue and meaningful expecting synergies. [#100](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-100)
Outside Europe, we announced the acquisition of Acquaflash in Brazil, contributing around EUR 8 million in revenue. [#101](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-101)
Finally, in France, we acquired Muller in the Grand-Est region, generating approximately EUR 7 million in annual revenue. [#102](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-102)

In addition, Adrett, announced at the end of December, will contribute in '26 on top of the plus 0.6% carryover impact from 2025 transactions. [#103](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-103)
Looking ahead, our 2026 pipeline is as active as last year, supporting continued disciplined bolt-on execution. [#104](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-104)
Moving on to the next slide, we present the 4 strategic rationales that typically drive our M&A activity. [#106](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-106)
This framework was discussed in detail during our Investor Day in May. [#107](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-107)

We have also categorized this year's acquisition according to these 4 buckets to give you a clear view of the strategic logic behind each transaction. [#108](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-108)

As you can see, most of the deals completed in '25 were aimed either at consolidating our market position in geographies where we already operate or at securing additional industrial capacity. [#109](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-109)
In many cases, acquiring capacity is more efficient and faster than building a new plant from scratch. [#110](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-110)
And sometimes, both rationales are combined within the same transaction. [#111](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-111)

More selectively, we also use M&A to launch a new service not yet offered by Elis in a given geography or to acquire a complementary client portfolio. [#112](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-112)
Turning to valuation. [#114](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-114)
We remind you of the typical multiples we pay for bolt-on acquisition. [#115](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-115)

In 2025, we acquired EUR 91 million of annualized revenue for EUR 108 million, which represents slightly below 1.2x revenue on average. [#116](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-116)

This generally translates into an EBITDA multiple of around 5x before synergies, which can decrease to as low as 2.5x once synergies are fully implemented. [#117](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-117)
Overall, this slide illustrates both the strategic consistency of our bolt-on approach and the discipline of our valuation framework. [#118](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-118)
Moving on to the next slide. [#120](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-120)

The key structural initiative during the year was the further deployment of our new CRM platform, already operational in France, the Netherlands and Ireland. [#121](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-121)
These [ 2 ] centralized customer data covers the entire client life cycle, from lead generation to contract renewal. [#122](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-122)
It enhance our ability to cross-sell services, improves onboarding processes and reduce implementation lead times. [#123](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-123)
Importantly, it also allows more dynamic pricing practices aligned with local market conditions. [#124](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-124)
The rollout will continue across the group over the next 3 years and represents a significant lever for future organic growth. [#125](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-125)
In short, better retention, faster onboarding and more cross-sell. [#126](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-126)

Moving on to the next slide, I would like to provide an update on our Pest Control and Cleanroom businesses, which remain high-growth and high-margin activities within the group. [#128](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-128)

Cleanroom delivered plus 8.5% top line growth to EUR 275 million with robust commercial momentum despite a slightly more constrained client spending environment. [#129](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-129)
We opened a third cleanroom laundry in Germany near Mannheim, reinforcing our leadership in Europe. [#130](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-130)
Innovation continues to differentiate us, notably with reusable solution made from recycled PET materials. [#131](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-131)
Pest Control grew by approximately 9% to reach around EUR 80 million in revenue. [#133](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-133)
We expanded to Latvia, marking our entry into the Baltic region. [#134](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-134)
The loss rate improved by 2.5 points across all countries, reflecting stronger execution and client satisfaction. [#135](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-135)
Organizationally, most countries now operate under a dedicated business unit structure, increasing operational focus and expertise. [#136](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-136)
These 2 businesses continue to reinforce our service portfolio and overall value proposition. [#137](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-137)
Also, we operate in 31 countries. [#138](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-138)
Cleanroom services are available in 21 countries and Pest Control services in 13 countries. [#139](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-139)

Leveraging our established platform to further deploy these services across our network offers substantial midterm growth opportunities. [#140](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-140)
Let's now take a look at each of our geographies. [#142](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-142)

France, first, where revenue growth was entirely organic at plus 3.3% in 2025, just like in '24, with margin up 10 bps at a record level of 41.9%. [#143](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-143)

Top line growth was driven by commercial momentum in workwear despite the more complex economic and political context and by hospitality, which benefited from a favorable comparable base during the summer and solid activity at year-end. [#144](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-144)
The slight EBITDA margin improvement was driven by volume growth and continued improvements in industrial processes. [#145](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-145)
In Central Europe, revenue at constant exchange rates increased by 8.1%, including 3% organic growth. [#147](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-147)
Belgium and Netherlands delivered solid performance. [#148](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-148)
Growth in Germany was more moderate due to a challenging health care environment. [#149](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-149)
Recent acquisitions contributed 5.1% to the region's annual growth. [#150](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-150)
The EBITDA margin improved by 50 bps year-on-year. [#151](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-151)
Germany recorded a 90 bps margin improvement driven by operational efficiencies and favorable energy purchasing condition. [#152](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-152)
Moving to the next slide. [#154](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-154)
Scandinavia and Eastern Europe delivered 1.9% organic growth. [#155](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-155)
Outsourcing momentum remained solid in Finland, the Baltic states and Norway. [#156](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-156)

The competitive environment in Denmark, while still challenging, gradually improved throughout the year, and FX was a tailwind in the region. [#157](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-157)

The EBITDA margin increased by 20 bps, supported by operational improvement, particularly in the Baltic region as well as by the gradual improvement in the competitive landscape in Denmark. [#158](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-158)
In the U.K. [#160](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-160)
and Ireland, organic growth reached 2.6% despite macroeconomic headwinds. [#161](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-161)
Commercial momentum in flat linen and workwear remains solid. [#162](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-162)
Pricing adjustments were implemented to offset cost base inflation. [#163](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-163)
Hospitality performance was mixed, with softer activity during the second and third quarter. [#164](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-164)
The EBITDA margin reached 32.4%, up 70 bps year-on-year, driven by productivity gains in workshops and improved logistic efficiency. [#165](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-165)
Moving on to the next slide. [#167](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-167)

Latin America delivered 8.2% organic growth, reflecting strong commercial momentum and continued outsourcing development, particularly in health care in Mexico. [#168](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-168)
However, the region was impacted by an 8% negative FX effect due to currency depreciation. [#169](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-169)
The EBITDA margin declined by 130 bps. [#170](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-170)

This reflects recent social policy decisions, including minimum wage increases, gradual reductions in working time and additional premium pay requirements. [#171](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-171)
We progressively implemented pricing adjustments during the year, which led to sequential improvement in the second half. [#172](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-172)
Southern Europe. [#174](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-174)

Revenue increased by 11.2% at constant exchange rate, reflecting strong activity levels, solid commercial momentum and contribution from recent acquisition. [#175](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-175)

Growth was particularly supported by strong performance in hospitality, while we also continue to expand our workwear outsourcing offering across the region. [#176](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-176)

Across the main markets, Spain, Portugal and Italy delivered similar levels of organic growth, demonstrating the strength and consistency of our regional position. [#177](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-177)
In addition, 2 flat linen acquisitions completed in Spain contributed 4.4 percentage points to regional growth this year. [#178](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-178)
Turning to profitability. [#180](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-180)
The EBITDA margin improved by 100 bps to reach 33.7%. [#181](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-181)
This improvement was mainly driven by higher volumes and more favorable energy procurement conditions. [#182](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003676656-182)
